articles.title: Angel Reese DOMINATES Game 2! Atlanta Dream Even WNBA Finals vs. Golden State | Chiney Today
articles.summary: Angel Reese took over Game 2 of the WNBA Finals! 🔥
body: After dropping 30 points and 16 rebounds, Angel Reese led the Atlanta Dream to a 79-65 victory over the Golden State Valkyries, evening the championship series at 1-1 and handing Atlanta its first WNBA Finals win in franchise history.

Rachel DeMita joins Chiney Ogwumike for this Game 2 reaction to break down Angel's dominant performance, the Dream's defensive intensity, and the offensive struggles facing Golden State in Game 3. From Gabby Williams' minutes to Natalie Nakase's rotation decisions, what adjustments will the Valkyries need to make as the Finals shift to Atlanta?

Plus, Bay Area rapper P-Lo stops by to talk about the electric atmosphere inside Ballhalla, his Filipino heritage, rapping with E-40, producing for Drake, and his Mount Rushmore of Bay Area athletes and artists!
